legacy_source_derivation: Replace all integer-hole-residual/v1 strings with integer-offset-constant/v1. All bodies, intent, cases, bindings and budgets remain unchanged.
pairing: Same three-activity task and checks; candidate grammar changes. This compares language construction, not model ranking.
performance_limit: Sequential one-pair observation on a shared host, warm caches not reset; development tests may run concurrently. Resource values describe these commands, not a controlled speed comparison. macOS time -lp values are rounded; RSS is its per-command process-tree high-water observation, not aggregate simultaneous memory.
probe_count_scope: Each generation receipt counts its own training probe evaluations; preflight and replay repeat pure probes. Recorded probe counts are not whole-command totals. Replay retains prior selection-attempt evidence without making new selection attempts.
known_limits: One scalar Integer input and one hole; 1..128 training cases; 2..16 retained candidates.
Zero/one observations are heuristics; nonlinear, branch-dependent and wrapped behavior must pass ordinary full-body scoring.
Training, holdout, native output expectations and unique disjoint input cases have different denominators.
No claim of natural-language understanding, model accuracy gain, all-domain correctness or external adoption.

negative_regressions.body: let factor = hole; return input + factor * factor
negative_regressions.scope: Retained unit-test observation, not part of the three-activity native task.

reproduction: Build cmd/gooo from compiler_revision with Go 1.27.1.
Produce the legacy source using legacy_source_derivation.
Run body-compose --source SOURCE --cases examples/body-codegen/hole-context-composition-cases.json --go-bin GO1_27_1 for each source.
For the contextual run, use --out NEW_DIRECTORY. Replay with --composition NEW_DIRECTORY/composition.json and the original contextual source and cases.
